_comment: FALLBACK running order. Read this before editing it.
The game asks the database first, via game_tracks() in schema-v18.sql, which
returns the CURRENT top version of every song flagged game_ok. That is the
path you want: upload a new mix through S'music and the game is playing it on
the next load, with nothing to remember and nothing to edit here.
This file is only used when that call returns nothing — v18 not applied yet,
no songs flagged, or no network. The versions pinned below were the newest of
each song on 11 Aug 2026 and they do NOT update themselves. Treat anything
here as possibly stale, because that is exactly what it is.
Every track plays start to finish, crossfading into the next, and the list
loops at the end. The game does NOT switch songs to match what's happening on
screen — a bong phases whatever is playing and drowning muffles it, but the
album runs straight through underneath.
Neither path can reach an unreleased mix by accident. get_library(band,
password) needs the band password and the game is a public page, so it holds
no password at all; game_tracks() is public but can only see songs someone
deliberately ticked. Everything else in the library stays private.
'src' is the object path inside the public 'tracks' bucket, with or without
the leading 'tracks/'. To read the real paths, open S'music signed in and run:
(await libRpc('get_library', {})).songs.flatMap(s =>
s.versions.map(v => ({ title: s.title, version: v.name, src: v.src })))
'treasure' names what the chest gives away, and is used by BOTH paths. One
title or an array of them — the chest can hold several tracks and shows a
download button per track. Titles have to match the list that's live; any
that don't are skipped, and if none match at all the chest falls back to
track one rather than offering nothing.
